index_growth.bound_derivation: A compressed binary tree over 128-bit record IDs has at most 128 branch edges plus a leaf on one path. Read traverses one path. Save performs lookup plus path-copy upsert: at most two path reads and at most 128 replacement branches plus a new branch and leaf. A full binary tree with N leaves has N-1 branches: audit/unlock read 2N-1 nodes of 57-byte leaves and 82-byte branches. The authenticated head is exactly 129 bytes. Timings are observations, not gates.

record_operations.bound_derivation: The existing128-bit key space bounds a selected path by129 nodes. Delete performs lookup plus removal and one promoted sibling:129+130=259 reads, at most127 replacement ancestor puts and129 obsolete selected-path nodes. Two-record pages are an explicit caller-sized fixture matching the browser experiment; they require at most2*129 node reads and retain at most2 proofs plus129 frontier frames. Complete traversal reads each canonical node once; each page and cursor creation reads a129-byte head. Total enumeration is linear even when retained page/frontier memory is bounded. The464-byte current content-three envelope is176 bytes of framing plus32 metadata and256 payload fixture bytes. Timing/allocation observations are not production SLOs or budgets.
